symptom: MDL001 (nested loop) warns on every loop inside a loop, e.g. an intentional region x plan-type iteration, about 5 times per script
cause: the rule fired on `loopDepth > 0` alone, although its own message is only about the key-lookup case
insight: A heuristic must test the shape its message describes: an IF inside the inner loop whose condition reads both the inner and an outer iterator. Independent cartesian iteration stays silent
